title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
provenance: Reported by Jirawat2307 (highball-db#181, 2026-09-22): rated 5, perfect, Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.32, DXMT with the Metal HUD on and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, 39 minutes played through Highball, and in a follow-up comment the HUD hovering around 110 to 120 fps. masxsimo2003 (highball-db#311, 2026-10-04), Apple M4, macOS 15.7.9, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, DXMT, recipe steam, rated 5 of 5 after 221 minutes, with fullscreen covered by the camera as the one flaw. Not run here. Deandrejpg (highball-db#597, 2026-10-20), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, recipes steam, warframe and vcrun2022 in the bottle, rated 5 of 5 after 13 minutes, menus fine. PhenixShade (highball-db#810, 2026-10-29), Apple M5, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXMT with Retina pixels at 100% and a 60 fps cap, recipe steam, rated 5 of 5 after 49 minutes.
notes: Reported perfect four times on DXMT on the default engine, most recently on an M5 with r29 and macOS 27.2 (49 minutes, Retina pixels, 60 fps cap). On an M4 Pro with macOS 26.6.2 and engine r5 the Metal HUD hovered around 110 to 120 fps over a 39-minute session, by the reporter's follow-up. On an M4 with macOS 15.7.9, Highball 0.10.3 and engine r19 a 221-minute session was perfect apart from fullscreen being covered by the camera, the MacBook's notch cutting into the picture, the same thing a Dimraeth report saw. The anti-cheat map has no entry for this game and neither reporter mentions a kick or a ban. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: In fullscreen the picture runs under the MacBook's camera notch (reported on an M4, macOS 15.7.9, DXMT, engine r19)
knownIssues.cause: Not investigated here. The game fills the whole screen including the strip beside the camera, as Dimraeth does
knownIssues.fix: None confirmed on this game. On Dimraeth, with the same symptom, playing windowed worked
